blocks.text: These terms apply to window cleaning, end-of-tenancy cleaning, regular cleaning, deep cleaning and small moves provided by Kraken PFM (Kraken, we) for private households. Different conditions apply only if accepted in writing.

The calculator shows the price for your declared details and selected scope for fixed-price services. With the same scope, that price stays unchanged. Hourly moves show an estimate; actual work is billed in 15-minute increments after the minimum duration. Moves with a starting price require photos or a visit before the final price is confirmed; payment is unavailable until then. An enquiry alone does not confirm an appointment. A contract is formed by confirmation of a quote or online booking. The booking confirmation defines the scope. Different details or additional work are agreed with you before the price changes. The existing 15% deposit stays unchanged; for hourly moves it is based on the minimum order including travel and any combined cleaning and discount.

All prices are in Swiss francs (CHF). The calculator price relates to the selected scope; chosen extras appear in the total. The confirmed quote and agreed scope apply. Kraken is not registered for VAT (annual turnover below CHF 100,000). No VAT is shown on invoices.

Ordinary travel for cleaning and fixed-price moves is included in the displayed total. For hourly moves the travel flat fee is included as a separate line in the estimate. Exceptional travel expenses require prior agreement and must appear in the written quote.

Payments are processed via Payrexx, bank transfer, or QR-bill. Balance is due within 7 days of invoice. Default interest of 5% p.a. applies, plus reminder fees of CHF 20.00 (2nd reminder) and CHF 50.00 (3rd reminder). Collection costs are borne by the client.

Cancellations must be in writing. Fees: >48 hours notice: free; <48 hours: 50% of price; <12 hours, no-show, or cancellation at door: 100% of price. One free rescheduling is permitted >24 hours prior, subject to availability.

Recurring plans are indefinite. Termination requires 30 days’ notice to the end of a month (7 days during the 2-month trial). Skipping a visit requires 48 hours’ notice. Prices may be adjusted once a year with 60 days’ notice.

Includes free rectification of landlord-identified cleaning deficiencies. Valid if: (a) notified in writing within 24h of inspection with protocol/photos; (b) inspection is within 72h of cleaning; (c) property remained unoccupied. Does not cover wear and tear, structural defects, or excluded items.
You provide an accurate inventory. Cash, jewellery, hazardous substances, plants and animals are excluded from transport without a written agreement. Hidden damage must be reported within 3 days.

You provide access, electricity, running water, heating and the planned lift. If access is not provided, the existing cancellation conditions apply. Keys handed to us are stored securely and anonymously.

Inspect work on completion. Visible defects must be reported within 48h; hidden defects within 48h of discovery (max 7 days post-completion). Primary remedy is rectification. Proportionate invoice withholding is allowed only for affected parts.
Information about any applicable insurance cover is set out in the relevant policy documents and written quote. Please clarify questions with Kraken before the job.

sections.title: 13. Subcontractors, Specialized Partners & Right of Refusal

blocks.text: Kraken may engage qualified third-party specialists but remains the sole contractual partner. Kraken reserves the right to refuse or terminate service if conditions pose safety or health risks.

Neither party is liable for delays or non-performance caused by events beyond reasonable control (natural disasters, strikes, pandemic, power failures). Obligations are suspended for the duration. If lasting >30 days, either party may withdraw.

We process personal data compliant with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP) and GDPR. Before/after photos may be taken for quality control and insurance. Marketing use of photos requires prior consent.

Kraken may amend these T&Cs with 30 days notice. Non-objection constitutes acceptance. If any provision is invalid, the remaining provisions remain unaffected and are replaced with a valid clause closest to the economic purpose.
All contracts are governed exclusively by Swiss substantive law, excluding CISG. Place of jurisdiction is Schaffhausen, Switzerland. Mandatory consumer places of jurisdiction remain reserved.
